resolutions.title: Progressive hook contradiction
resolutions.resolution: Progressive is explicitly exempted from the pdf-state-* card-hook requirement (no card, no copy, no eyebrow, no pdf-state-progressive id) and given a canonical non-card hook set via the existing page-column contract.

canonical_hooks.page_nodes: data-rendered="false" while unrendered, data-rendered="true" once painted (existing .gno-pdf-page[data-rendered] contract from task .3, globals.css:540-556)

resolutions.task_6_procedure: Playwright page.route() delays /api/doc-asset range responses on the large fixture (R18); assert without sleeps.
task_6_assertions: simultaneously at least one [data-rendered="false"] node exists with non-zero width/height matching its getViewport aspect
screenshot at that moment is the R8 progressive evidence artifact
resolutions.wording_fix: Spec R8, the canonical-copy table row, and task .4 (Key context + per-state-hook acceptance item) now state the exemption, so 'every state hook' cannot be read as requiring a progressive card. Task .4 adds a DOM assertion that progressive renders zero pdf-state-* nodes while both rendered and unrendered page nodes exist.

resolutions.title: Fallback predicate, copy, and actions

predicate.evaluation: per render from doc; not cached, not derived from mime/ext, ignores frontmatter
predicate.consequence: Fallback never fires for null, empty, or whitespace-only extracted text, including every scanned PDF; those keep the viewer's actionable error card on Pages.

impossible_requirement_removed.was: fallback notice combined with the empty/whitespace-only 'No extracted text' sub-state
impossible_requirement_removed.now: The 'No extracted text for this document.' sub-state is reachable only by manual Text selection and is never accompanied by a fallback notice.
removed_from: .flow/tasks/fn-112-native-pdfjs-document-renderer.5.md (approach bullet, DOM-test list, both acceptance blocks)

fallback_notice_table.body: This PDF could not be rendered. View the extracted text or download the original.
fallback_notice_table.note: Approved register string, byte-exact; only place it appears in the product.

fallback_notice_table.body: This PDF is password protected. Showing the extracted text instead. Download the original to open it in a PDF reader.
The document could not be loaded from this session. Showing the extracted text instead. Switch to Pages to try again, or download the original.
The PDF viewer could not start in this window. Showing the extracted text instead. Download the original to read it.

resolutions.action_set_rationale: Exactly one control per notice (Download original). No retry control: retrying means switching back to Pages via the existing showRawView pill, which is also what clears the notice; a second control would give two paths to one behavior and require state the toggle contract does not have. The network copy names that path in words.
resolutions.mutual_exclusion: At most one pdf-fallback-* node at a time, never together with a pdf-state-* node; viewer cards exist only when the predicate is false, notices only when it is true.
